_help: Copy this file to secrets/applicant_profile.json and fill in your REAL details. That path is gitignored. These fields are used ONLY to auto-submit applications to ATS endpoints that accept them without a captcha/login. If a form asks something not covered here, the tool will NOT guess — it falls back to preparing the application for you to submit.
_screening_defaults_help: Optional default answers to common yes/no screening questions. Keys are matched case-insensitively against the question text; only used when a required question clearly matches. Anything not covered aborts the auto-submit for that job (falls back to prepare).
